versionRationale: Initial explicit rank oracles and strict provider-subset outcomes. Expected digest changes require a fixture version change and a behavior rationale, never automatic snapshot replacement.

rights.origin: Project-authored synthetic rank/policy fixtures; canonical text and refs reused from pinned local lexical/selection fixtures. No external provider calls.

expectedOutcomes.no-lexical-match: Lexical rank contribution zero; semantic-only ranking or empty when both channels empty.
expectedOutcomes.exact-id-vs-semantic-noise: PostgreSQL exact identifier plus rank-2 semantic hit outranks rank-1 semantic-only noise regardless of score scale.
expectedOutcomes.duplicate-tie: One contribution per exact ref per channel; score ties sorted by stable chunk ID; overlaps omitted without widening.
expectedOutcomes.timeout: unavailable unless explicit allowDegrade and optional stage
expectedOutcomes.allowed-lexical-degradation: degraded=true; effectiveProfile=lexical-v1; warnings identify failed stage, including empty results
expectedOutcomes.forbidden-fallback: Denied/unknown/incompatible, required-stage failure and pinned full-space mismatch remain failures.
